credits_text: RAINE MATEO SIMON BAKER CHRISTIAN SLON EMMETT HANLY
other_text: A NEW FILM BY RAINE MATEO "THE FARAWAY PLACE" IS A HAUNTING AND MYSTERIOUS STORY THAT EXPLORES THE BOUNDARIES BETWEEN THE LIVING AND THE DEAD. THE FILM IS A COLLABORATION BETWEEN RAINE MATEO AND THE DIRECTOR OF "THE HAUNTING OF HILL HOUSE" AND "THE WINDING ROAD."
description: A poster features a woman with horns on her head, eyes closed, in a forest setting. The title 'THE FARAWAY PLACE' is prominently displayed at the top.
